arStrings.szText:
While in Human form, {c_important}Critical Striking{/c} enemies with {c_important}Nature Magic{/c} {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} times grants you Anima of the Forest for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

While infused with Anima of the Forest you gain the {c_important}Perfect Storm{/c} and {c_important}Earthen Might{/c} Key Passives.
